response.sql: WITH scope_stats AS (SELECT u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as mean_of_averages FROM scope_stats) SELECT ss.acctscope, ss.avg_net_fee_rate, ss.record_count, ss.avg_net_fee_rate - om.mean_of_averages as deviation_from_mean FROM scope_stats ss CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
